summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Intermap Technologies, a foreign private issuer, submitting a press release dated July 8, 2026. The press release announces the expansion of the company's Aquarius RMA platform with property valuation analytics and continued adoption by Czech insurers, along with plans to enter additional European markets. It is a product update and business development announcement without any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change. No deal terms are disclosed. The filing is informational and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
